meta.name: agent-harness-architect
meta.description: Design or review the operational harness around single-agent, multi-agent, and tool-using AI systems. Use when building agent platforms, routing layers, tool interfaces, memory systems, evaluation harnesses, human checkpoints, permission boundaries, cost controls, or agent-computer interfaces that must remain observable, testable, and safe under real project work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计一套可控可测的AI代理运行框架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在为AI代理系统设计可靠的运行框架，需要兼顾可观察性与安全性。
copy.tagline_en: Design a controllable and testable operational framework for AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing reliable operational frameworks for AI agent systems, ensuring observability and safety.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会先读内置参考文档,确认目标类型与风险级别,然后设计或审查 AI 系统的外围框架——调度、工具、记忆、权限、评估等,让系统行为有边界、可观察;最终产出契约、权限模型、故障清单和仓库更新计划。
howto.when: 当你要构建 AI 系统外围,比如智能体平台、路由层、工具接口等;或涉及记忆、评估、权限等需要可观察、可测试、安全的部分时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个单智能体的运行框架,包含路由、工具和权限边界。
say.note: 会产出路由、工具与权限的契约和模式选择。

say.text: 审查这套多智能体系统的评估与记忆方案,并列出风险。
say.note: 会对照风险清单评估反馈路径与记忆设计。

say.text: 为我的工具接口写出契约、安全门和停止条件。
say.note: 会指定输入、输出、错误处理与权限范围。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads the reference file, confirms type and risk, then designs/reviews the AI wrapper (routing, tools, memory, permissions, evaluation). Outputs: contracts, permission model, failure-mode table, repo update plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build the wrapper for single/multi-agent or tool-using AI systems: agent platforms, routing layers, tool interfaces, etc.; or for memory, evaluation, permission, etc.

say_en.text: Design a single-agent harness with routing, tools, and permission boundaries.
say_en.note: Will produce routing, tool, and permission contracts.

say_en.text: Review this multi-agent evaluation and memory design; list the risks.
say_en.note: Checks feedback paths, failure modes, and safety gates.

say_en.text: Write contracts, safety gates, and stop conditions for my tool interface.
say_en.note: Specifies inputs, outputs, errors, permissions, stop rules.
